verdict.rationale: Apple's support page does publish some concrete specs (core counts, 546GB/s memory bandwidth, Thunderbolt 5 speed, display support limits) [apple-m4-max-docs-20, apple-m4-max-docs-19, apple-m4-max-docs-18], but the vast majority of the newsroom material is marketing adjectives ('blazing speed', 'ultimate choice', 'rips through workloads') rather than a full spec sheet with clock speeds, power/TDP figures, or AI TOPS numbers with test conditions. Community threads focus on unverifiable benchmark submissions rather than confirming any official detailed spec disclosure. Missing for 10: published clock speeds (GHz), power/TDP figures, explicit AI TOPS metric with documented test conditions, and independent corroboration of these numbers.
